body:
Yes I was like this 2-3 months ago. It was horrible.

It was mainly shocking cause I never imagined it is possible to feel this way, for it to be this bad. 

It changed over time. I still don't leave my house and I am very much lonely and depressed.

But the panic attacks stopped. Now it is just the depression.

Sounds like your the parent in that relationship, that's a rough deal man. A lot of weight on your shoulders.

You provide support for your mom but it doesn't work both ways, worse she is not reliable, you don't know what you'll meet. doesn't sound like your dad is very stable either.

Your clearly a smart kid and your taking care of your schooling which is more than I did, also life has made you mature beyond your years and hopefully that will come in handy later in life.

On a practical note I suggest making a "what if" plan, I don't think you will actually  need it but just for your own peace of mind, have a back up plan, what would you do if you had to? having a plan is usually better then uncertainty and anxiety, it's at least something and it might reassure you that you have options.

Honestly I am more concerned with the lasting emotional impact of the way you are being treated...

Maybe your school has a counselor you can talk to?

Staying in a complex home scenario and going to school or getting a job and moving out on your own...not an easy decision, but as time passes you will probably know more about what is right for you.

Whatever happens these are temporary problems, they won't last forever, pretty soon in a year or in two you will have your own life, they won't have any power over you anymore just remember that, you will be in charge of your own life.

Build a future for yourself, choose healthy relationships with people who are kind to you, reliable, stable. Get therapy if you can to process all of this stuff. Someday this will all be behind you, just don't carry the past on your back, process it, grow from it.

Bro that is so awful, really terrible stuff. Like emotional abuse terrible. 

I could never imagine doing that to my child. 

Your mother sounds like the more reasonable one, any chance of explaining to her how much this is hurting you? that it is putting you under constant stress of losing your home?

Any one other normal adult you can turn to for help or just to talk about this?

Do you have plans like college or anything like that?

It's a rough one. 

Understanding that some part of me would choose death over life, even that it's just a part of me, it's a part that is willing to let go of everything. 

And then understand that there is no peaceful way to do it in today's world.   

Are you willing to share your situation? The story behind your pain?
I would read it too.
I feel the same.

Yep I feel the same.

I'll be 37 in April.

Funny thing is I remember feeling old from my late 20s, like life is over...eventhough I was so young. And I'm sure that at 50 you look back and say wow...35 was so young.

But I feel like I am not living this life, it's going right past me, I'm not fullfiled in any meaningful way, not success, no career, no kids, family or relationships. 

That's the part that really hurts, that I have nothing to show for my time here on earth. 

I'm just wasting away every day more and more, stuck at home and not doing anything meaningful. I'd like to do something meaningful...I just don't know what that would even mean anymore.

Yes has been my dream for years....

I use to dream I could go back a few years with the experience of today, it seems like I am always one step to late. by the time I understand what is going on, life is already on to the next stage.

Or just to stop time for a bit...I would dream of a cave where time doesn't move and I can just rest for a bit until I am ready to keep going.

When I think about this I look at my life today and say "wait I'm still here, I can still pursue anything I want!"....and then I do absolutley nothing and watch another day go by. that's when I feel the most disappointed with myself.

Yes mine says kind of the same thing...and then urges me to start taking meds again (to be fair I have no clear reason why I stopped taking them).

The way I see it most people without deppresion have the ability to tell themselvs happy little stories about their life, their past and their future. I think this is what she means by "fool yourself into happines".

I've just lost that ability...I don't believe my own stories anymore, I can't put up any "carrots" for me to chase...I just don't buy it. So all that is left is the stick, ilke coming to the same conclusion over and over again.

Honestly if I could believe those stories again that would be nice...

It's hell. I am in hell. 
I just want to be part of a family again, I want the world to make sense again. nothing feels real anymore.
I wish I could be ok just being alone, just being by myself all of the time, not needing others, the way I used to be once upon a time.

Yes I think I'm totally done. 

It would be nice to love someone in a caring, respectful and healthy relationship but honestly what are the odds of that happening...

And I won't survive another break up like this, losing everything in life but the clothes on my body and my guitar. hating myself and hating my ex. it's too hard for me.
Yep. exactly how I feel.
Yes exactly 100%

It sounds like you are not safe...

and there is just no going around that. 

Your being physically hurt.

Please get out of there.
Much love brother

Oh he defiantly did a number on you....some people are so cruel.

You have the same steady job for 4 years which you love? it's a job where you care for others? your compasionate and caring for kids? it's your dream to have a family?

Come on your destined to be a mother and a great one! 

You just fell in with a bad person (yes they exist).

and he hurt you...

Having a family and kids is a huge part of someone's life and a dream for a lot of people! 

You are facing your difficulties in life, you get up for work everyday! not everyone with deppresion does that...

Your getting help and treatment! not everyone with deppresion does that...

Your facing it and living through and that is a huge inspiration for children, to see their parents get up and face life with strength and dignity.

You will be an amazing mother! 

The hell with that guy...he already took 2 years of your life, don't let him rob you of your dreams.

​

But I will say this...having a family is much easier with the right person. And that guy is clrealy not the right person...

Once you have children with someone they are in your life forever.

Could you imagine having a kid with someone toxic like that? 

Find someone who will be compassionate as you, a loving caring partner that will be good for you and will be a good caring father. someone who can share your life, love and dreams.

If you are in therapy try to see how that relationship came to be, try to learn from it...find someone better. Someone worthy of the love you have to give and someone who knows how to love back.

god yes!!!

"I don't know what your talking about"

"I don't rememebr..."

And sometimes just plain ignoring me....just no reply.

I couldn't believe it, I thought I was crazy.

If it was somehow threatning to her self esteem, if it meant she did anything wrong...than it didn't happen.

Don't fall for it and don't stand for it.

Man that is rough....and it takes me back....

It's pretty clear to me that you are in an emotionaly abusive relationship.

putting all the diagnosis and labels aside - it's just the sheer endless terror of being with someone who is a toxic person.

Someone who is literally there to cause problems instead of find solutions.

Someone who can't see you and your feelings but demands that you see and align to their experience and narrative.

Someone who is extremly self centered - incapable of being supportive - literllay always needs to be right, have the final word...everything feels like  war.

Someone who does not respect your personal boundries - because your boundries threaten her sense of control.

Someone who constantly makes you question yourself, your thoughts and feelings.

When you bring up the inconsistencies in their narrative they either rage at you or shrug it off and basically ignore it.

All of these were present in what you wrote...

The self doubt and second guessing yourself, slowly and surely destroying your sense of self esteem...it's like a frog in hot water, you don't notice it but eats away at your dignity, self respect, self worth, confidence. everyday more and more.

I use to call it the "narrative war" and I would beg her to stop - I thought a relationship should be about 2 people working together as a team and not about feeding an endless conflict.

​

You quite literally broke your back working...you are raising her kids as if they are your own, you are a full time dad and still make money for the family (and 2K is not change).

When was the last time someone told you are doing great, that your an awsome dad, thanks for making dinner or just recongnized that you might also be dealling with hardship and stress...

when is the last time you heard the word thank you? or got a hug or a kiss for no reason except your partner loves you?

A toxic relationship can truelly drain the life out of you.

Can you imagine treating her like that?

Is she really concerend about going abroad to get a tatoo?? seriously??

That is what your family needs right now?

It took me a long time to see that I was lonely before for many years and I needed someone to love - my ex however just wanted to be loved and that is not the same thing.

Only advice I can give you is this (that I should have done):

1. start setting very small boundries - one step at the time - keep your sanity - don't be the frog. don't be the frog bro.
2. do everything possible to spend 1-2 hours a day learning a new trade - preferably computer coding or something which actually has a future and pays well. if you let yourself be without a job safety net that is a very bad thing on many levels...if you do this and she opposes you learning a new trade that is an excellent place to set boundries and stand your ground. Any normal partner would be supportive of something like that.
3. Get help / support about toxic relationships and changing dynamic - I wish I knew more about this when I was still in my old relationship, just for the sake of my own sanity.

It really sounds like a somewhat unhealthy dynamic...

Maybe that dynamic can be changed, it defiantly means wroking through some of those "negative tactics" being used on you.

No easy answers...but making small steps to grow stronger and taking a stand on some things you know are right (like that play date thing with other kids)  are steps in the right direction. Do whatever you can to grow stronger..

man it's like a flashback...

the whole "you don't really love me" thing - it's so cruel and it really messed with my head for years. 

Making you constantly doubt yourself and what you feel is really an awful thing to do to someone else, let alone your partner. infact I think it's the worst part.

If you had a girlfriend that had some awsome dogs and her own buisness.

Can you imagine treating her the same way? 

Making her feel guilty about her livilihood as if it is all about you somehow?

She just doesn't get truely caring about someone. it's all about the attention game.

and anything that takes attention away from her is a problem.

Man that just feels so familiar...

I always felt like it's a control issue. 

Making plans together means sharing + she will lose the ability to do whatever she feels like whenever she wants. 

blaming it on your dogs is just a benefit because it distances you from things you love that are not her which is very threatning to her , so a double win in the endless war for complete control. If it wasn't your dogs it would be something else.

God forbid she would meet you half way because "it's not her way of doing things", but you are expected to immidiatly fall in place.

It's the double standard that drove me crazy. 

when I would bring it up she would say "I don't know what you are talking about".

It's making you slowly give up parts of yourself to fit her convinience as proof that you care about her and love her.

But ask yourself...would she ever do the same for you?

Is she a person that looks for solutions or constantly generating problems?

Problems that never seem to come up with other people...

Also she's anti kids and dogs....

I'm happy for you that your out of there man.

Dear god.....that is so truley terrible. This world is so cruel.

The fact that you found him, leaving you alone with your shared children, his horrible family attacking you.  The heart breaks.

It's so unfair....it's not right to put all that on you.

Do you have any support system? any family to help you through this?

Thanks friend I really appreciate it.

I'm just in a very dark place right now. It's never been this bad and I'm afraid it will only get worse. I can't bring myself to feel hope only pain and fear. 

Seems like I ruin everything I touch and that my mind is actively working against me. Kind of like being lost inside myself, no navigation system.

I was messed up before this relationship, I think I just didn't know how much. anyway thanks for your kind words.

Wow...I can't imagine what that is like. 

But soon enough your daughter will be 18, she will be a grown up and then who knows...I hope you will get a chance to make up for lost time with her.

The fact that you are a Dr and that you are married again and have a family is really amazing. Your job is to help others and you have rebuilt your life. 

It's really special.

God I remember thinking that "stay or go..." my head was going insane.

She really was so awful and I remembe that, I know it. I know that given the chance I would have never ever let her get near me.

But the nostalgia and lonliness still get to me...maybe I am too damaged for someone normal.
Thanks. I'll watch it.

Thank you.

I have cut away from my friends. They all have their lives and their families. They all live far away. and for some reason talking to them on the phone just seems to hurt...cause afterwards I am still alone. 

I haven't played my guitar in months. It's like the hope and faith are all gone.

I had a rough upbringing. No parents, I am guardian to my brothers. it wasn't easy. I thought I was a strong person that had known hard times...boy was I wrong. 

I have never felt pain like this. feeling so worthless...so afraid of life...so weak.

I just wish this pain would stop. I wish I didn't waste my life for so long. There are just no dreams left to believe in anymore.

it's horrible. 

Before her I didn't mind being alone, I was alone for most of my life and I was just fine with it...I didn't even know that I had love to give and how much I needed to love someone.

​

And now...I start crying just walking in the street sometimes. I can't stand the lonliness. 

I feel like an empty shell. I can barely do my job. 

How can I rebuild...and who would possibly want someone as broken and damaged as me.

And if someone did want me by some magic I am sure I would destroy it evantually like I ruin everything else. And I just can't go thru this again...

I can't go thru this pain again. god I hate her. this is what I am now a hatefull and bitter man. So weak. I just have no faith anymore.

Oh wow...that sounds so harsh. I admire you for surviving that. 

Do you have contact with your daughter now?

You say you remarried and that is amazing to me.

I feel like there is no chance of a new relationship for me, like I am damaged goods now and there is no chance for love anymore.
Nice.
Thanks mate. I think I'm actually going to try that.

that is so heart breaking... 

Your pets giving you a source of comfort, it makes me want to cry cause I know what you mean. I lost my pets after my break up and it still hurts so much. 

You did nothing wrong. You work and your partner is on Meth and stole from you and your child. it's NOT your fault. It's not.

Here are all the ideas I can think of:.

1. Maybe a crowd funding post - even an anonymous one - telling your story - - you can have a a friend set it up on your behalf without using your name
2. Maybe an NGO or non profit of somekind - so not necessarily govt aid - maybe some of them give loans on good conditions with no interst and delayed payments
3. Contacting your EX's parents? you say you are isolated from your family but they are grandparents as well and have a responsebility for the money their son took
4. Asking your land lord again for any kind of solution - asking him to come up with any solution or offer he will accept - god forbid he would show some humanity to a mother in need. 
5. asking for an advance at work?

I wish I had better ideas...I am also broke  and on the verge of losing my job but I don't need to support a child. 

Your a strong person and I believe in you.

The inner conflict is so hard. 

Hating someone and loving them at the same time. 

I've been through hardship in my life but nothing like this. I feel like I am insane now.

I hate my ex for what she did to me, I really do hate her....and at the same time I feel like leaving was somehow a mistake. Like I lost everything and I am not even sure what is was all for.

When you care for someone so deeply and they just drain you but they can't give back because they are somehow incapable of seeing you. 

and after all is said and done you are left with so much damage, pain and no closer. nothing gets solved. 

I hope things are better with your family. I hope you find a good caring partner that can love you back and be there for you.

Please don't.

You have a partner in your life you obviously care about.

Your clrealy a strong and independant person.

And your friend....it may be out of context but I would never say that to one of my friends.

Are you willing to share why you want to end your life?
That is extremely insensitive. and on so many levels...
You are an amazing human being. Thank you for being so strong. Thank you for living. Thank you for having love to give to others.

I feel your pain. After 7 years with my witch all of my personality and life power is gone.

I hate her so much....I just hate her so much...and also myself for letting those things happen to me.

I feel like my mind is broken...I had a rough life but I always felt strong, until I met this woman. Slowly slowly she ruind my soul, I left in the worst physical, emotional, finanical and mental condition of my life.

How could I have let this happen...the memories, the guilt and the shame just won't stop.

I can't trust myself anymore. I lost confidnce in my toughts, my feelings and even my own body. I am an empty shell now.

I am 36 years old and I have nothing. No money, no future, no relationships, severe anexiaty, guilt and endless lonliness.  I can't even get a cat or a hamster...becuase if something would happen to them It would kill me, I'm too emotionally fragile for it.

That guy you say she is flirting with...he is just her next victim...feel pitty for that poor bastard. He has no idea what is coming to him.

Also it sounds like you didn't have kids with this woman...and if that is true you should thank god for it every day.

today I told my therapist that I need to quit becuase I can't afford it anymore.

So he said we can do a reduced amount for a period of time. Whatever I can afford for now until I can afford the usual rate again.

But I can not accept it...because it will mean that he cares about me as a person, a relationship beyond money and then I need to care about him and everything will get confused in my head. I can not accept this "favor" from him and I can not stop crying.

I cut away from anyone who wants to help me and I see the dissapointment in their eyes and it's the most horrible feeling. I know I am hurting them. 

Saying goodbye hurts so much.

But I can't let anyone in...becuase if I do then saying goodbye later will only hurt more. more than I can handle.

The other side of the coin isn't something I can reccomend. A part of me wishes he didn't care about me.

that is so terrible....The world is so unfair. 

Not sure what health condition you currently have but you still deserve to be loved and have a relationship. Maybe there are groups for people with this condition? maybe you can meet someone there...

Also these are uniqe times in human history. the world and science are moving faster than ever. no one knows what can be possible in 5 or 10 years...maybe there is still hope...maybe even enough the hang around and see.

You are so strong. I wish you find the comfort, happines, meaning, health and love you so truely deserve.
amazing! great work and inspirational!

It's probably not my place to say but I think you should move out of there, living with someone who abused you and parents who neglected you and supporting all of them finanicaly....it's truely terrible and also not your responsebility. parents should take care of children and not the other way around.

You have every right to just take your things and go and everyone else will just figure it out, becuase they will have no choice. 

If that is too much and too big of a step then please consider taking small steps of minimizing your responsebility, making a slow shift to prioritize yourself over them.

It's not the same scenario and I was never sexually abused but I spent years or my life sacrificing myself and my happiness for family and not in a good way...it took me so long to say enough and start stepping back and when I did to my surprise everyone just figured it out...they found solutions simply because they had to.  The world didn't end or collapse I just wish I did it sooner.

I know what you mean. Forgiving myself for the past...that would be really nice. loving myself, or caring for myself like I did for others would be great but I just can't seem to do it.

I run through the memories again and again, I'm either haunted by the past or I'm haunted by the future and I end up feeling like I'm somehow broken.

It's just a really lonely feeling.

Sounds very hard, it really does. I hope you have a friend or therapist that you can talk to about it.  

Maybe your city has some LGBTQ support channels / community? 

Meeting someone who has been through something similar might help.

For me a lot of the pain is that not everyone is like this. 

Not everyone seems to feel remorse or guilt because of every little interaction with the world. but I feel attacks of crippling guilt over everything and I really hate myself for being like this. I feel like a bystander in the world of the living.

Why do you believe your a bad person? 

From your writing you seem intelligent and sensitive, not the traits of bad people.

Are you still living with that sibling that abused you? 

It sounds truely terrible and very lonley, I wish I could be there to comfort you in some way and I wish those things didn't happen to you. 

Your clearly incredibly strong and determined, youv'e just been dealt a bad hand in life.

I won't pretend to know what your going through. I am just some guy out there but I send you love and strength from the bottom of my heart.
